name: Bread and butter pudding
author: The Wickham family

ingredients.item: 60 g sultanas or dried cranberries, or a mixture of both

steps: Grease large shallow ovenproof dish with butter.
Arrange bread in dish with dried fruit sprinkled between layers.
Spread apricot jam on lower layer.
Beat yolks, eggs and castor sugar together until creamy.
Gently press bread down and leave to stand for 20 mins.
Place dish in roasting dish full of water in the oven (so water comes halfway up the dish).
Josh's notes: i put 200ml of Baileys in this pud. the more the better I say. it's my wife that says 4 tbps.
So some where in between the two values i suppose

culture.text: Bread and butter pudding is a bread pudding in British cuisine. Slices of buttered bread scattered with raisins are layered in an oven dish, covered with an egg custard mixture seasoned with nutmeg, vanilla, cinnamon, or other spices, and then baked.
